(Netra)nārāyaṇa
title of Āḷvāñceri Tamprākkal of Kauṣītaki Śākhā of Ṛgvedins, the spiritual head of Kerala Brahmins; there have been several patrons of literature in this family.

(Netā)Rāmakṛṣṇa_Bhaṭṭa
